summary: Gaminder v1.5 Phase 1 (Onboarding & Profile) VERIFIED END-TO-END. Backend pytest 18/18 PASS including 4 new v1.5-specific tests (signup persists city/recently_played_games/playtime_slots and returns onboarding_complete=false; server caps recent games at 3 and slots at 2; seed user novastrike and admin both return onboarding_complete=true). Frontend mobile flow verified on https://active-gamers-2.preview.emergentagent.com: (1) Signup screen renders City field, 'Recently Played Games * (max 3)' chip selector with a 4th chip becoming aria-disabled after 3 are selected, and 'Gaming Schedule * (max 2)' slot selector; (2) Submitting with empty recent games shows 'Pick at least 1 recently played game' and with empty slots shows 'Pick at least 1 gaming time slot'; (3) After a fresh valid signup the app routes to /onboarding/connect-steam — testID connect-steam-screen is visible, the exact public-profile notice text is rendered, the Help (?) icon (steam-help-btn) opens a modal containing steam-tutorial-gif-placeholder; (4) Seed login (novastrike@seed.gamingbuddy.app) and admin login (admin@gaminder.app) both bypass the gate and land directly on /swipe (no connect-steam-screen rendered). Cancel & sign out from onboarding also works. No deprecated Expo packages or red-screen errors. One minor non-blocking console warning observed: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a third-party lib (lucide/expo-linear-gradient).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' fires on /auth/signup and /auth/login screens. Not breaking — most likely originates from a third-party (lucide-react-native / expo-linear-gradient / RN Modal); not from project source. Track only if a future RN upgrade promotes it to an error. Reference: visible in browser console during signup + login navigation.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py routes are clean; SignupBody correctly defaults city='' and the route slices recently_played_games[:3] and filters/slices playtime_slots[:2] against PLAYTIME_SLOTS allow-list. me_user() exposes onboarding_complete properly.
Steam callback (server.py:1042) sets onboarding_complete=True on successful link — correct.
RootNav (_layout.tsx:20-34) gates on !user.onboarding_complete and redirects to /onboarding/connect-steam — correct and matches the spec.

server.py is now ~1129 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Future refactor recommendation: split into routers/auth, routers/swipe, routers/steam, routers/riot, services/compatibility, services/seed (carry-over from prior iterations).
